title: Duniya ke 10 desh jahan mardon se zyada hain mahilaen, dulhon ki pad gayi hai kami!
author: Galibazz Desk
description: Duniya mein kai aise desh hain jahan mahilaon ki sankhya purushon se kaafi zyada hai. Badalte social aur economic halaton ke chalte in deshon mein dulhon ki kami tak dekhne ko mil rahi hai.

1. Ukraine
2. Latvia
3. Lithuania
4. Russia
5. Belarus
6. Portugal
7. Hungary
8. Estonia
9. Armenia
10. Moldova

Ukraine is list mein sabse upar hai, jahan war aur migration ke kaaran male population mein lagataar girawat aayi hai. Latvia aur Lithuania jaise Baltic countries mein bhi mahilaon ki abaadi purushon se kaafi zyada payi jaati hai, jiska ek bada reason male life expectancy ka kam hona hai.
Russia aur Belarus mein bhi kai saalon se women population zyada bani hui hai. Iska kaaran historical factors, health issues aur men ki comparatively kam average age maana jata hai.
Portugal aur Hungary jaise European deshon mein aging population ek bada factor hai, kyunki women generally men se zyada jeeti hain, jisse female ratio badh jata hai.
Estonia aur Armenia mein job opportunities ke liye men ka foreign migration gender balance ko impact karta hai. Isi wajah se in deshon mein women population ka percentage zyada hai.

Moldova mein bhi kaafi sankhya mein men overseas kaam karte hain, jisse country ke andar mahilaon ki sankhya comparatively zyada dikhai deti hai. Experts ke mutabik, aisa gender imbalance future mein social structure aur marriage trends par asar daal sakta hai.

title: Din dhalte hi sarka diya **Sofia Ansari** ne pallu, ek jhatke mein bhula diya saara budget.
author: Galibazz Desk
description: Social media sensation Sofia Ansari ne ek baar phir apne latest post se internet ka temperature badha diya hai. Jaise hi shaam dhalti hai, Sofia kuch aisa share karti hain jo turant viral ho jata hai aur fans unke Instagram profile par lagataar visit karte rehte hain.

Sofia Ansari ki fan following kaafi zabardast hai. Unki tasveeron aur videos par kuch hi minute mein hazaron likes aur comments aa jate hain. Social media par unki popularity din ba din badhti ja rahi hai.

Sirf Instagram tak hi nahi, Sofia Ansari video songs mein bhi nazar aa chuki hain. 'Billo's Town' aur 'Chashma Pyar Ka' jaise gaane mein unke energetic dance performance ko darshakon ne kaafi pasand kiya tha.
Sofia social media par kaafi active rehti hain aur apne bold aur glamorous avatar se fans ko entertain karti rehti hain.

title: The couple is rumoured to marry on February _**_, 2026, at ______ Palace
author: Viral Baba
description: Actors Rashmika Mandanna aur Vijay Deverakonda apne kaafi time se charchit relationship ko lekar ek baar phir headlines mein hain.
Nayi reports ke mutabik, kaha ja raha hai ki yeh couple secretly engaged ho chuka hai.
Social media par posts tezi se viral ho rahi hain, jismein daawa kiya ja raha hai ki dono stars 26 February 2026 ko Udaipur Palace mein shaadi kar sakte hain.
In reports ke baad internet par speculation ka silsila aur bhi zyada tez ho gaya hai.

title: Mujhe porn star ka pati kehlane mein koi harz nahi
author: Viral Baba
description: Porn industry se Bollywood mein kadam rakhne wali Sunny Leone aur unke pati Daniel Weber apni ninth wedding anniversary celebrate kar rahe hain.
Dono ki love story kisi film ki kahani se kam nahi hai. Daniel aur Sunny Leone dono hi adult films ke star reh chuke hain aur 10 April 2011 ko shaadi rachai thi.
Reel life mein Sunny jitni bold dikhti hain, real life mein utni hi soft aur simple hain. Daniel ne bataya tha ki unhe pehli baar Las Vegas ke ek restaurant mein dekhte hi woh unhe dil de baithe the.

title: Ye viral Neta ji ,Who was the woman with the politician caught having relations on the road!
author: Social Desk
description: Delhi–Mumbai Expressway par ashleel video viral hone ke maamle mein BJP neta Manoharlal Dhakad giraftar hue hain, unke saath dikh rahi mahila ki talaash jaari hai, blackmailing ki aashanka ke chalte NHAI ke teen karmchariyon ko suspend kar diya gaya hai aur police ne mahila ke khilaaf bhi case darj kiya hai.

title: Viral Video Dekh Kar Toot Gayi Imsha Rehman: ‘Mujhe Laga Meri Zindagi Khatam Ho Gayi
author: Social Desk
description: Social media fame ne jahan Imsha Rehman ko star banaya, wahi ek viral video ne unki duniya hila kar rakh di. November mein leak hue alleged videos ke baad Imsha ne public life se khud ko alag kar liya. Ab pehli baar unka dard saamne aaya hai — fear, trauma aur death threats ke saath. Yeh sirf ek influencer ki kahani nahi, balki social media ke dark side ki ek chilling reality hai.

title: Naked Dress Hanging From Her Breasts Stunned The Red Carpet
author: Social Desk
description: At the 68th annual Grammy Awards in Los Angeles on February 1, 2026, singer Chappell Roan grabbed global attention with a daring sheer Mugler gown that challenged traditional red carpet fashion norms. The outfit became a major trending topic across entertainment media.
